US Senator John Kennedy Criticizes AI Developers and Economic Conditions

U.S. Senator John Kennedy has voiced strong criticism regarding artificial intelligence developers, describing them as 'high IQ stupid people.' He has also commented on economic conditions, stating that high prices are 'gutting the middle class like a fish.' In a separate statement, Kennedy advocated for aggressive action against Russia, saying the U.S. must 'choke [Putin] to death.' The coverage also notes an interaction between Senator Kennedy and Representative Jamie Raskin on September 6.
